intro: Welcome to **BrindleWood!** 🌿 Our goal is to create a friendly, welcoming community where everyone can relax, build, explore, and have fun. By participating in our Discord or Minecraft servers, you agree to follow these rules.

items.title: Be Respectful
items.body: Treat everyone with kindness and respect. Harassment, bullying, discrimination, hate speech, threats, and targeted behavior are not allowed. Respect boundaries and keep disagreements civil.

items.title: Keep Chat Comfortable
items.body: Keep conversations appropriate and use channels correctly. No spam, excessive profanity, NSFW/graphic content, or intentional disruption.
items.note: 🌎 **English is required in public BrindleWood communication**, including server chat and public Discord channels. This allows staff to properly understand conversations, assist players, and perform moderation duties. Other languages may be used in private conversations.

items.title: No Real-World Debates
items.body: BrindleWood is a place to enjoy Minecraft. Avoid arguments or debates about politics, religion, LGBTQ+ issues, or other divisive real-world topics. Sharing personal experiences is fine; turning them into debates is not.

items.title: Play Fair
items.body: No cheating, hacked clients, exploits, unauthorized automation, or scams. Follow each server's gameplay rules.

items.title: Respect the World
items.body: No griefing, stealing, or damaging another player's builds without permission. Respect claims, towns, kingdoms, and community projects.

items.title: No Unauthorized Advertising
items.body: Do not advertise other servers, communities, services, or websites without staff approval.

items.title: Respect Staff
items.body: Follow reasonable staff instructions. If you disagree with a decision, contact staff privately rather than arguing publicly or harassing staff.

items.title: Privacy & Safety
items.body: Do not share personal information, threaten others, scam members, or attempt to access another person's account or private information.

items.title: Common Sense
items.body: Not every situation can be listed. Staff may act against behavior that harms the community, disrupts others, or attempts to bypass these rules.

enforcement.title: ⚖️ Enforcement
enforcement.body: Breaking the rules may result in warnings, mutes, kicks, or temporary/permanent bans depending on the severity and circumstances.

closing: ❤️ **Thank you for helping make BrindleWood a place everyone can enjoy!**
